questions.stem: Which Fishing camp object unlocks at skill 140?
questions.explanation: The Fish Bowl comes at skill 20, the Fishing Rack at 140 and the Fishing Hut at 300.

questions.stem: How do you get Artisan Fishing?
choices: from the Clamlette Surprise quest at level 35
questions.explanation: Nat Pagle teaches Artisan Fishing at level 35. The Clamlette Surprise quest is how you get Artisan Cooking.

questions.stem: Which Legacy perk gives a chance of an extra fish?
questions.explanation: Luremaster gives a chance of an extra fish. Master Chef gives extra cooking results, and Gourmand makes food buffs last longer.

questions.stem: How much does the Fish Bowl add to all stats?
questions.explanation: The Fish Bowl gives 8% to all stats. The 10% is Blessing of Kings, which it does not stack with.

questions.stem: Your group has no Paladin. Which Fishing camp object gives 8% to all stats?
questions.explanation: The Fish Bowl gives 8% to all stats, so it helps most in groups without a Paladin.

questions.stem: Your group has Blessing of Kings and you place a Fish Bowl. Which of the two gives the bigger bonus to all stats?
questions.explanation: Blessing of Kings gives 10% and the Fish Bowl 8%, and the two do not stack.

questions.stem: Grilled Squid is one of the seafood raid foods. What does it give in Forever?
questions.explanation: Grilled Squid now gives +1% crit. Nightfin Soup gives +22 spell damage and Mightfish Steak +40 attack power.
